title: A Matrix-Theoretic Exact Formula for Counting Primes in Intervals Between Consecutive Odd Squares
summary: Matrix $B=(b_{ij})$ with $b_{ij}=(2j+1)(2j+2i-1)$ was introduced in \cite{Shi2024} as an additive sieve for odd primes. In this paper we introduce the minimal-anchor function $\pmin(d)$, the least odd prime $p$ such that $p+d$ is prime (sequence A020483 of the OEIS at index $d/2$), whose finiteness for all even $d$ is exactly the weak Polignac (Maillet) conjecture, i.e.\ the statement that every row of $B$ contains a semiprime.
